source: General Directorate of Agriculture (GDA), Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, Cambodia — Sweet Corn Production Handbook (ផលិតកម្មដំណំពោតផ្អែម), in partnership with SNV
text:
Before planting, seed should be soaked in water for 4-6 hours. After soaking, coat the seed with Captan (Captance) 50WP fungicide at a rate of 300 grams per 100 kg of seed, to protect against fungal disease.

Planting depth is 3-5 cm in the rainy season and 5-8 cm in the dry season. Plant 1 seed per hole as good practice — farmers should keep an extra 20-30% of total seed in reserve for filling gaps where seeds fail to germinate. Total seed requirement is about 25-30 kg per hectare.

Recommended row and plant spacing options (from the handbook's spacing table):
- 75 cm between rows x 50 cm between hills, 2 plants/hill → about 54,000 plants/ha
- 75 cm between rows x 25 cm between hills, 1 plant/hill → about 54,000 plants/ha
- 80 cm between rows x 50 cm between hills, 2 plants/hill → about 50,000 plants/ha
- 80 cm between rows x 25 cm between hills, 1 plant/hill → about 50,000 plants/ha
- 70 cm between rows x 30 cm between hills, 1 plant/hill → about 47,000 plants/ha
